title: How We Designed Our First Game
summary: A look at the design process of our first game and the challenges we faced.

body.content: When we started our first game, we knew it would be a challenge. From planning to execution, every step taught us something new.
In this blog, we will share how we managed to complete our first title and what we learned along the way.

title: Optimization in 2D Games
summary: Tips on how to improve the performance of 2D games in engines like Unity and Godot.

body.content: One of the biggest issues in 2D games is maintaining stable performance, especially on low-end devices.
In this article, we explain key techniques to optimize graphics, physics, and logic in 2D games.
